_comment: THE list of mod modules CI builds and the launcher bundles (src/mods/versions/<module>).
Read by build-check.yml, launcher-release.yml (via tools/release/plan.py) and the
release's 'bundled jars present' assert. Adding or removing a live version here is
one of the promotion coupling points listed in src/mods/VERSIONS.md.
'covers' = the Minecraft versions players can pick that run this jar (mirrors
VersionManager.OriginBuilds); it is the human label on build jobs and release notes.
